Uses of Package
org.apache.juneau.console

Packages that use org.apache.juneau.console
Package
Description
org.apache.juneau.console
Engine-agnostic themeable admin-console chrome: Theme, the stock theme stylesheets, the bundled chrome.css asset, and ConsoleChromeMixin.
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker
FreeMarker-only delivery of the admin-console chrome: the reserved-classpath base.ftlh template, the <@tag> macro, and ConsoleFreemarkerMixin (registers a reserved-path ClassTemplateLoader on top of the host's own FreemarkerMixin configuration).
org.apache.juneau.console.test
Test helpers for console pages: PageContractAssert asserts on the #juneau-page contract of a rendered page instead of on rendered chrome HTML, and AssetResolutionAssert asserts that every asset a page links resolves.
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.dev
Petstore console Developer pages: custom cards, themes, rendering flavors and the secure API demo.
